metadata.scenario: A prospect wants to know more about the availability of virtual therapy sessions and how they are conducted. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Robert Jackson. I'm a client of yours and I was wondering about the availability of virtual therapy sessions. Hi Robert! It's great to hear from you. Yes, we do offer virtual therapy sessions. Oh, that's good to know. Can you tell me how those sessions are conducted? Certainly! Our virtual therapy sessions are conducted through a secure video platform. We typically use Zoom or a similar service to ensure privacy and ease of access. That sounds convenient. Do I need any specific equipment for the session? Ideally, you’d need a device with a camera and microphone, like a tablet or smartphone, and a stable internet connection. Okay, I have a tablet. How long do these sessions usually last? Our virtual therapy sessions generally last about 45 to 60 minutes, similar to in-person sessions. And what kind of therapy can I access virtually? We offer physical therapy and occupational therapy sessions virtually, focusing on rehabilitation and daily living skills. That's good to hear. Are there additional costs associated with virtual sessions? The pricing is similar to our in-home sessions. For example, physical therapy is priced at $110 to $140 per session. Got it. I’ll need to check with my neurologist to see if they think this would be beneficial. That makes sense. Would you like me to send over some additional information about our virtual therapy services? Yes, that would be great! Can you include the pricing and how to set up an appointment? Absolutely! I’ll send you an email with all the details. Can I confirm your email address? Sure, it's robert.jackson@email.com. Thank you, Robert. I’ll send that over right away. I appreciate it. Also, can I have the direct number for my physical therapist? Of course! You can reach Dr. James Rodriguez directly at +13165559215. Thanks, Margaret! I’ll follow up with him as well. You’re welcome! If you have any other questions or need assistance, feel free to call back. Will do. Have a great day! You too, Robert! Take care.
